mapper.insert: INSERT INTO address (user_id, name, phone, province, city, district, detail, is_default) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detail}, #{isDefault})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, name, phone, province, city, district, detail, is_default, create_time, update_time FROM address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, create_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id, name, phone, province, city, district, detail, is_default, create_time, update_time FROM address WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE address SET is_default = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE address SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
